title: Phase 6A.1 E1 research vs Phase 6B live semantic comparison

headlineAnswer.question: What did Phase 6A.1 E1 research use for stage selection when charge=1 exists on an eligible stage?
headlineAnswer.answer: Pure W2 lowest-value among ALL eligible (non-max) stages. Charge is ignored during selection. choose_stage_a1 does not prefer charged stages; apply_wind_key then charges or upgrades whichever stage W2 returned.
headlineAnswer.liveBehaviour: If any eligible stage has charge==1, restrict pool to those charged stages, then W2 lowest-value among that subset (UPGRADE). Else W2 among all eligible (CHARGE).

rtpGapNote: Doc 19 attributes live ~+0.66 pp vs E1 research partly to charged-stage priority EV (plus stream noise).
